methods.label: Plain product advert — real photo, price overlay

process_steps: 1 - Source: the REAL product photo. No AI render, no prompt - re-rendering made products plasticky and dropped hardware (learned 2026-07-26).
2 - Cut out: BiRefNet on CPU (never fights the GPU for VRAM) - handles ring holes and chain gaps.
3 - Compose: hybrid advert - true-scale cutout + price overlay (make_hybrid.py; price/wholesale from the BALDRICK product record - drives the caption, never painted into the image).
4 - Finish: JPEG. Save: D:\Generation\<CLIENT>\<yyyy-mm>\.
5 - Upload via BALDRICK API -> asset host. GATE: awaiting-approval in BALDRICK.

methods.notes: Deliberately NO AI render and NO prompt: re-rendering made products plasticky and dropped hardware (learned 2026-07-26). Real photo, always.

methods.label: Person wearing the real garment — Qwen edit

process_steps: 1 - Source: the product image named by the job (the client's site photo or the brief's source_image_url), downloaded with timeout+retries.
2 - Render: Qwen Image Edit on the 5090 - qwen-product-ugc-v001.api.json (20 steps, cfg 2.5; never the 4-step Lightning, it reads as an advert).
3 - Finish: JPEG quality 90; the PNG master (full workflow graph embedded) stays in D:\ComfyUI-Data\output.
4 - Keeper copy: D:\Generation\<CLIENT>\<yyyy-mm>\ (client-agnostic: the code comes from the job).
5 - Upload via the Baldrick API to <client>/produced/; job reports done -> awaiting-approval.

THE METHOD ENDS AT THE GATE. What happens after approval (folders, crops, filing) belongs to the CLIENT'S PROCEDURE - e.g. workflows\procedures\8b-lifestyle-catalogue.md for 8Ball. Methods never carry a client's journey.

methods.label: Product on a surface — SD3.5 scene + true-scale cutout

Iron On Patch.prompt: candid close-up photograph of the back of a person wearing an ordinary everyday mid-blue indigo denim jacket, natural medium wash with soft fading, real cotton denim weave, visible seams and orange topstitching, soft natural daylight outdoors, softly blurred street background, photographic, authentic real jacket

process_steps: 1 - Source: real product photo, cut out at true scale (BiRefNet).

2 - Scene: SD3.5 renders the surface - sd35-ugc-scene-v001.api.json; the surface prompt comes from THIS row's settings per product type (e.g. patches on denim). Pin badges banned from UGC (Stephen 2026-07-27) - they take the plain advert instead.
3 - Compose: ugc_composite drops the true-scale cutout onto the scene (make_ugc.py).
4 - Finish: JPEG. Save: D:\Generation\<CLIENT>\<yyyy-mm>\. Upload via BALDRICK API. GATE: awaiting-approval in BALDRICK.

methods.notes: Pin badges removed from UGC 2026-07-27 (Stephen): placement never convincing — they fall back to the plain advert. Surface prompts live in settings here, not in code.
